blocks.title: Collections, not books
text: This section holds **downloadable collections**: worksheet packs, lesson-plan collections, model-paper collections, revision packs and similar.
Complete books and ebooks are a separate section, [RCF Publications](rcf-publications/).

blocks.heading: How to pay
intro: Open the panel below when you are ready to buy. Include the resource's product code so we know exactly what you have paid for.

intro: Grade groups run from Primary through Grades 6 to 9, G.C.E. O/L and G.C.E. A/L. Skills covered include reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, listening, speaking, literature and examination practice.

blocks.title: This is the paid teacher area
text: RCF English has **two** teacher areas, and they are not the same. This one holds paid collections.
The free one is [Teacher Resources](teacher-resources/): lesson plans, worksheets, marking guides and teaching notes that cost nothing and always will.

blocks.heading: Teacher resource collections
